text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a walk in the park on my day
off
when I hear someone call
out to me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence, meeting you here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm strolling around without a
destination...
Or put simply, I'm just
taking a walk. I
often spend my weekends doing so.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My friends like to say that I'm good at
idling away time, but as an
American, I
find the scenery here to be a delight.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even on my days off, I grow
restless if I don't get at least a
little
exercise.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I can enjoy the spirit of this country
as I
move through it... Walking is
a form of
entertainment for me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still,
I've seen all there is to see in this
area, so I'm pondering where
to go next.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere good for a walk? That would
be wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you know of some delightful areas
that I'm not yet familiar
with.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I gladly accept your offer. Let's
have a nice stroll, just the two
of us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come up with a few places she might not
be aware of, and we set off
together to
see them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To think there was a tea house tucked
away so close by. I had no
idea!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely slice of Japanese tradition,
undisturbed by the trendy
boutiques
around it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Look, so many items on the menu use my
favorite
ingredient—matcha. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but it may have been a mistake
coming here. These sweet treats
are so
tempting... ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass and I continue our walk, visiting
various local places of
interest...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I enjoy my usual quiet walks, but today's
outing has been delightfully
stimulating
too. You've shown me so many things.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Where shall we go next, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking on Grass Wonder's request, I
have a look around and
happen to see
something interesting.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
An arcade? I can't say I'm very familiar
with such places...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It might also not be the best place to
have
a calm and relaxing walk...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Something new...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's true. In the course of our walk so
far, I've made a number of
such
discoveries.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...All right.
Since I'm on this rare walk with
you, I shall trust in your
advice.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It really is a lively place.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what sort of game is this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder curiously eyes a dance
game controlled by foot
movement.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A game one plays by performing dance
steps? It sounds not unlike a
Winning
Concert.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What? Who... me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well... I have been trained in dancing, so I suppose I might be able to...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll do it. But please,
don't laugh
when you see me making a
mess of things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder begins playing while I
watch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um... Hm... A-ah?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My winning concert experience... didn't
exactly translate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I certainly enjoyed myself
nonetheless. I even got some
exercise out
of it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know there were games like this.
I'm learning about many new
things today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This is yet another discovery I've made
thanks to our walk together.
Thank you
very much for coming with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'd love it if you could join me for
another
walk sometime. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now, let me try this just once more...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"To speak without words"... Amazing, you
understood my reasoning
without the need
for explanation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Keep watching—I'm going to clear this
next one.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... This is more difficult than I
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My—are you jesting? Why, I've still barely
begun to exert myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm going to play one more
time. For the exercise, you
understand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our day together continues until Grass
Wonder finally masters her
dance game
skills.
